Overview 
 ADNS combines a feature-rich Private DNS client with a native NextDNS integration, giving you full control over your device's DNS settings and your NextDNS account.
 Three Ways To Use ADNS 
 1. Private DNS Client 
 Use ADNS as a fast Private DNS controller when you want direct control over system DNS without using a VPN. Requires a one-time Shizuku or ADB setup.
 Turn Private DNS on or off with a single tap
 Apply automatic Wi-Fi rules for specific networks
 State notifications so you can quickly see whether DNS is active
 Quick Settings tile for instant toggle access
 Choose your preferred provider and filtering options when supported (ads, trackers, malware, adult content, and safe search)
 Supported providers include AdGuard, Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, OpenDNS, NextDNS, and custom hostnames
 2. Native NextDNS Client & Manager 
 Use ADNS as a full NextDNS app when you want to manage your account without opening a web dashboard. Requires a NextDNS account (no Shizuku or ADB needed).
 View and edit every NextDNS profile setting right from the app
 Inspect NextDNS logs and detailed statistics
 View setup guides for all devices and platforms
 100% native Android experience - no WebViews involved
 3. NextDNS + Private DNS Integration 
 Use ADNS to link your NextDNS account directly to your device's DNS settings and keep both sides in sync. Requires a one-time Shizuku or ADB setup.
 Seamless integration with all ADNS features (Wi-Fi rules, notifications, and Quick Settings tile)
 Automatic NextDNS setup handled entirely for you
 Custom device name support (appears in your NextDNS dashboard, statistics, and logs)
 One-click NextDNS profile switching that updates the system DNS settings for you
 Disclaimer 
 ADNS is an independent project and is not affiliated with NextDNS in any way.

fdroid:com.calmyjane.spacebeam.summary: Kaleidoscope Camera Fun with Shaders for live visual performances!
fdroid:com.calmyjane.spacebeam.description:
SpaceBeam transforms your camera feed into a psychedelic, real-time geometry pattern generator. It transmits the image as a second screen
 to be shared over miracast or hdmi.
 Features:
 * kaleidoscope, Droste spiral, 3D tunnel and swirl effects
 * Front/Back Camera as Input source
 * RTSP as input-source
 * Image/Video (playlists) as input-source
 * Generative Shaders as input-source, built-in shaders include CalmyJane logo animations
 * Feedback as input-source
 * Different merge modes (add, subtract, multiply ...)
 * Hand tracking: control parameters with finger pinch, hand tilt and hand distance
 * Face tracking: control parameters with head tilt, distance and mouth width
 * Accelerometer/Gyroscope as modulation for parameters, look around in the tunnel effects
 * Bluetooth MIDI controller as modulation source
 * BPM tap, beat synced LFOs and beat synced preset transitions
 * 9 presets slots with smooth transitions between presets
 * Auto-Play mode, timed in seconds or in beats and bars
 * Undo/Redo buttons
 Recommended Setup:
 Run this app on a Samsung Android device (e.g. Samsung S20 FE). Samsung is the only system still supporting miracast. Look for the option "Smart View".
 Connect to any smart TV/Projector that supports miracast. Or connect to a miracast-hdmi-dongle.
 Optional: Use a second phone as remote camera. Take the second phone, install "IP Webcam" app.
 On main phone, host a wifi hotspot, or bring both phones into the same external wifi.
 Select the rtsp input in the app and enter the address "rtsp://192.168.30.40:8080/h264_ulaw.sdp" (the IP adress is shown on the remote cam phone when the server is running).
 You should get a remote image from the second phone through quite some distance.
 Alternatively to using IP Camera, you can use "Screen Stream" App to share another phones screen and make visuals out of any app (recommended apps: Fluid, Frakls ..)
 This way you can very easily create stunning visual art setups all just with a phone and not tons of cabling and heavy computers with expensive software.
 Hope you enjoy this, if you do, send me a mail :)
 info@calmyjane.com
 www.calmyjane.com
Permission Notes:
Camera is the live input. Hand and face tracking analyze the camera image on the device only, nothing is stored or sent anywhere.
Network Usage is needed for streaming Videos from other devices into the app. The app does not communicate with the internet. If your OS allows, you can block Network Usage for the app, this will cause error message when trying to add RTSP sources, but otherwise won't affect the apps performance.
Modifying System Settings is needed to force the screen timeout to infinite. The "keep screen on" flag doesnt work on all devices, if your screen turns black you can force it on in the settings menu. This needs permission to modify system settings. No other settings except screen timeout are touched by the app.

fdroid:com.gideontek.phonetrack.name: PhoneTrack SMS
fdroid:com.gideontek.phonetrack.summary: Location sharing over SMS — so simple. GPS phone tracking with permission.
fdroid:com.gideontek.phonetrack.description:
PhoneTrack SMS lets people you trust locate your phone with a text message. No internet, no account, no cloud and no data plan. This phone tracker works wherever you can receive a text.
HOW IT WORKS
An approved contact texts your keyword. Your phone texts back a map link to its GPS coordinates, with its location accuracy and battery level. They don't need the app and there is nothing to sign up for. For regular check-ins they can subscribe to updates every few minutes, each showing how far and in which direction the phone has moved.
YOU STAY IN CONTROL
* A new number that texts your keyword waits for your approval. Nothing is sent until you tap Approve; blocked numbers are ignored.
* An optional PIN locks the app's settings and approvals, so nobody else using the phone can switch it off or approve themselves. Parents can set up a child's phone, approve their own number and keep the PIN.
* No internet permission, no account, no tracking, no ads.
FEATURES
* Location on request, or the last known location without waking the GPS
* Periodic updates with distance and direction moved
* Choose what each reply contains: coordinates, accuracy, battery, time, map links
* Limits that protect your SMS bill from floods
* Simple-to-use Phone Track app
* Free software (GPL-3.0)
GOOD TO KNOW
* Set location to "Allow all the time" so a text can start a reply while the app is closed.
* Turn off RCS chats for these conversations: Android hides RCS from apps, so those texts never arrive.
* Needs Android 8.1 or later and a SIM that can send SMS.

fdroid:com.pedronveloso.a11ybutton.name: Accessibility Button Launcher
fdroid:com.pedronveloso.a11ybutton.summary: Assign one app or app shortcut to the Android accessibility button
fdroid:com.pedronveloso.a11ybutton.description:
Accessibility Button Launcher lets you assign one installed app, or one of its app shortcuts, to the Android accessibility button or accessibility shortcut that is already built into Android.
Because it uses the operating system's built-in accessibility trigger, the integration stays simple and low-friction. You use the same system control Android already provides instead of a custom overlay, floating tool, or extra launcher layer.
When the accessibility trigger is used, the app launches only the app or app shortcut you selected. This keeps the experience direct and lightweight while working with the platform behavior that Android already supports. If the saved app or shortcut is no longer available, the app explains what needs to be fixed instead of failing silently.
What it does:
- Assigns one launchable app, or one app shortcut such as composing a new message, to the accessibility button or shortcut
- Leverages Android's built-in accessibility button for a native-feeling integration
- Guides you through a short first-run setup, with a clear status of what is left
- Helps recover when the accessibility service is disabled after an app update
- Asks Android to stop restricting the app's battery use, and adds extra background-protection guidance for devices that aggressively stop accessibility services
Privacy and permissions:
- No analytics, advertising, or crash reporting
- No cloud sync and no network data collection
- Settings are stored only on your device
- Optional in-app logs for troubleshooting are off by default, stay on your device, have sensitive values redacted, are deleted when you turn them off, and are shared only if you choose to
- The accessibility service is used only to respond to the accessibility button or shortcut
- The battery optimization exemption is used only so the system does not put the service to sleep
The app is open source and built for people who want a simple, focused way to launch one app from the system accessibility trigger.

OpenBanners Overlay is a companion app for doing mission banners in Ingress Prime.
Share a banner link from OpenBanners or Bannergress with the app and it shows a small overlay on top of Ingress:
• A route map at the top of the screen with the steps of your current mission (labelled 1a, 1b, …), the start of the next mission, and your own position. It zooms so your nearest open steps are always in view.
• Mission controls: see which mission you are on and open the next mission in Ingress with one tap.
• Steps are ticked off automatically when you get within range, with an optional notification.
• Passphrases: copy a mission's passphrase with the 🔑 button on the mission card. Choose the mission number, or crowd-sourced passphrases shared by other players on OpenBanners (optional, off by default).
• Optionally show the whole banner: completed missions, the current one and the ones still ahead, each in its own colour.
• Choose your own colours for the current mission, upcoming missions, completed steps and your position.
• The map turns with your compass, or keep it north up if you prefer.
• Arrange the mission card your way: choose and reorder its buttons, and make it wide, tall, smaller or larger.
• Share your layout with friends, or import theirs.
• Optionally back up your settings to OpenBanners and restore them on another phone (sign in with Bannergress).
The overlay lets touches pass through to Ingress, so you can keep playing as usual.
Free and open source (MIT): https://github.com/Gamer1120/OpenBanners-overlay
Based on Banner Overlay by The Bannergress Team. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Bannergress or Niantic. Ingress is a trademark of Niantic.

fdroid:ua.com.radiokot.lnaddr2invoice.summary: Allows paying to email-like Lightning addresses from unsupported wallets
fdroid:ua.com.radiokot.lnaddr2invoice.description:
Some popular Bitcoin Lightning wallets, like Muun, don't support email-like Lightning addresses.
This app allows paying to such addresses by turning them to convenient invoices.
It doesn't add any extra fee to your payment.
This utility is launched when you interact with addresses in your browser or other apps. Here's how it is done:
Clicking an address
Sometimes, a Lightning address is a clickable link, just like an email. When you click it, LN Address to Invoice appears.
Selecting an address
Often a Lightning address is just a text. In this case, select it and in the appeared system menu look for the "Send sats" action.
Copy-pasting an address
You can always just copy an address and paste into LN Address to Invoice with the Paste button in the header of the intro screen, or with the "Paste address" launcher icon shortcut.

Hardware-accelerated 3D is recommended, ideally with support for OpenGL Shading Language.

firefox-addons:3016641.name: Sublern — AI Translate Words in Video Subtitles
firefox-addons:3016641.summary: AI video translator. Generate subtitles from video/audio. Hover words: translate, pronounce, save, study with SRS & Scramble
firefox-addons:3016641.description:
Sublern — AI-Powered Translation & Subtitles for Video
Watch videos on any site and instantly translate unfamiliar words using AI without switching tabs.
Sublern is a comprehensive AI-powered tool that translates words in real time and generates subtitles even when they're missing. Simply hover your cursor over any word in the subtitles — and you will see the AI-generated translation, usage examples, and be able to listen to the correct pronunciation. If the video has no subtitles at all, Sublern can generate them from audio or video using built-in speech recognition. Everything works right on top of the video, without distracting you from watching.
🎯 Why do you need Sublern?
AI-powered translation and subtitle generation make any video accessible for language learning. Sublern helps you learn languages, turning your favorite videos into personalized lessons powered by artificial intelligence. Subtitles become interactive — any word can be translated with one mouse movement. And if subtitles are missing, Sublern creates them for you.
✨ How does it work?
Open any video on your favorite site.
If subtitles are missing, Sublern generates them from audio or video.
Hover your cursor over a word in the subtitles.
An AI-powered dictionary instantly appears — translation, examples, and a pronunciation button.
Move the cursor away — the window disappears, and you continue watching.
🧠 Learn with SRS & Scramble
Turn your saved words into active knowledge. Practice with two powerful study modes:
• SRS flashcards — spaced repetition helps you remember words long-term.
• Scramble game — assemble the word from mixed letters to improve spelling and recognition.
⌨ Keyboard shortcuts
Control everything with hotkeys: toggle subtitles on/off, pause translation on hover, show alternative translations, enable usage examples, and turn pronunciation on/off — all without touching your mouse.
📚 Learning languages through video — a new level
Learning languages through video with Sublern happens naturally and without stress. You watch interesting content, and the AI-powered extension helps you understand unfamiliar words. Context and examples reinforce new words in memory much more effectively than rote memorization. And with built-in subtitle generation, you're never limited to videos that already have captions.
Sublern works on any site with video and text subtitles — from popular streaming platforms to educational websites. Even if subtitles are hard-coded into the video or missing entirely, Sublern can generate them for you.
🔊 Pronunciation and examples
Each AI-generated translation includes:
• Accurate translation of the word in context
• Usage examples in real phrases
• Pronunciation button to hear native speakers
🌍 Translation languages
Translate words from English to Russian, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, and other languages. The translation language can be set with one click.
⚡ Why Sublern is the best choice
Traditional way: Stop the video, select and copy the word, open a new tab, paste into a translator, miss the moment.
Sublern: Video continues, just hover your cursor, translation right on the video, instant result, miss nothing. And with subtitle generation, you can watch any video, even without captions.
🔧 Settings to customize
• On/Off — toolbar button for quick activation
• Translation language selection — from the dropdown menu
• Auto-play — enable or disable pronunciation
• Subtitle generation — choose between video-based OCR or audio-based speech recognition
❓ Frequently Asked Questions
Which sites support subtitle translation?
All sites with text subtitles, including streaming platforms, educational websites, and video sharing services. If subtitles are missing, Sublern can generate them.
Can Sublern generate subtitles from any video?
Yes. If subtitles are hard-coded into the video (burned-in), Sublern uses OCR to read them. If there are no subtitles at all, it uses speech recognition to transcribe audio.
Does the extension slow down video?
No. Sublern uses local processing in your browser and does not affect loading or playback speed.
💬 We value your opinion
We hope Sublern makes learning languages through video engaging and productive. If you like the extension — please rate it. This will help other language learners find a video translator that actually works.
Send your ideas and suggestions in the reviews. Together we will make Sublern even better!
Learn languages, watch your favorite videos, and expand your horizons with Sublern! 🎓🎬

firefox-addons:3107796.name: Sp1ke Manga & Image Translator
firefox-addons:3107796.summary: Translate text inside images on any website. The text is read on your own device and the translation is drawn right over the picture. 22 languages.
firefox-addons:3107796.description:
NEW in version 1.4.5: the extension has a brand-new theme! The settings window and the floating button now have a black-and-white manga style. This update also adds a learning mode that shows the original text under each translation, sound effects shown as small labels, and a names glossary for each series that you can export and share.
Sp1ke Image Translator reads the text inside pictures on a web page and shows the translation right on top of the image, in a matching style, so you can keep reading naturally.
Features
 Translates the text inside images on any website, drawn over the original speech bubbles.
 Finds the language of the pictures by itself, even when the page is in another language.
 Click (or tap) a translated bubble to see the original text, copy it, or correct the translation by hand.
 Names glossary: write how a name should look once, and it is used on every page – for all websites or just the series you are reading. Export and import lists to share them with friends.
 Learning mode: see the original text in small letters under each translation.
 Translate an area: drag over any part of the screen to translate it (Alt+Shift+S, desktop). Alt+Shift+Y translates the picture under the mouse.
 Next chapter in advance: once a chapter is done, the next one is prepared in the background (desktop).
 Read aloud: the translated bubbles can be read out loud, in order, with your browser's voices.
 Reads horizontal and vertical text, including Japanese and Chinese columns.
 Sound effects drawn on the artwork can be translated, shown as a small label so the art stays visible, or left as they are.
 Optional: add your own DeepL API key for higher-quality translations.
 The extension's own menus follow your browser language.
Private by design
 Images are read on your own device and are never uploaded.
 Only the extracted text (never the image) is sent to an online translation service, because Firefox has no built-in offline translator.
 Your glossary and DeepL key stay in your browser.
 No accounts, no ads, no tracking.
You stay in control
 Tap the floating "Translate?" button and choose "Translate now", or turn on "Always translate on this site" for the sites you read often.
 On desktop you can also right-click an image and choose "Translate this image".
 "Don't show on this website" hides the floating button on sites where you don't need it.
 Or choose "Show only on" and list the websites where the floating button may appear; it stays away from every other site.
 Hold Shift to peek at the original, or press Alt+Shift+T to switch back and forth (desktop).
 Choose the font, text size, background style and letter case.
Works on Firefox for Android too. Open the extension's settings from the Firefox menu (⋮ → Extensions → Sp1ke Image Translator).

firefox-addons:2967697.summary:
Access your TeamPass vault directly from your browser. Features secure autofill, quick search, and password generation with Zero-Knowledge AES-256 encryption. The official extension for collaborative password management.
Requires Teampass ≥ 3.1.5.23
firefox-addons:2967697.description:
TeamPass is a professional-grade, open-source collaborative password manager designed for teams and organizations that prioritize security and granular access control.
This official extension allows you to interact seamlessly with your self-hosted TeamPass instance directly from your browser, eliminating the need to switch between tabs to manage your credentials.
📢 Dependencies & Compatibility
Extension v1.7.0+: Requires TeamPass server v3.2.1.0 or higher
Extension v1.6.3+: Requires TeamPass server v3.2.0.2 or higher to benefit from the extension's automatic configuration feature.
Extension v1.6.0+: Requires at least TeamPass server v3.2.0 to function.
🛡 Enterprise-Grade Security
TeamPass is built on a "Zero-Knowledge" architecture where your data remains encrypted.
Encryption: Uses RSA 4096-bit and AES-256 bit encryption standards.
Privacy: Your master password is never stored; decryption happens locally to ensure maximum confidentiality.
Compliance: Full audit trails and logging for every action taken within the extension.
🚀 Key Features
Quick Search: Instantly find your items and folders through a lightweight interface.
Smart Autofill: Automatically detect and fill login forms on your favorite websites.
On-the-fly Generation: Create strong, complex passwords that meet your organization's security policies.
Secure Synchronization: Real-time access to your shared folders, personal items, and roles-based categories.
Multi-Instance Support: Easily switch between different TeamPass environments.
⚙ How to use
Install the extension.
Enter the URL of your organization's TeamPass instance.
Provide your API key (generated from your TeamPass user profile).
Log in and start managing your passwords securely.
🎫 Commercial License Required
Use of this extension requires a valid commercial license. To obtain a license and register your instance, please contact nils@teampass.net .
Before users can install and use the browser extension, administrators must configure the server-side settings in Teampass.
🌐 About TeamPass
TeamPass is specifically designed for environments where passwords are shared among teams with complex access requirements. It integrates with Active Directory (LDAP) and OAuth2, offering a robust alternative for managing sensitive data at scale.
For more information or to contribute, visit our official repository: https://github.com/nilsteampassnet/TeamPass

The Priority Health app keeps your coverage at your fingertips; ensuring quick, reassuring, and anytime access to your health plan.
With this “members only” app you can quickly and easily:
• View your member ID and access your plan documents.
• Find in-network doctors, hospitals, labs and more.
• Review claims and coverage activity.
• Track your out-of-pocket spending.
• Estimate and compare procedure and visit costs ahead of time.
• Find prescription cost and coverage details.
• Access wellness services and opportunities.
• Connect with a Priority Health customer care specialist.
When you download and log on, personalized app features are based on the coverage and activities included in your own plan. Download your app today.

apple-macos:6812456607.description:
Weathervane is the dashboard for your Ecowitt weather station. It connects to your gateway or console over your own Wi-Fi, or to Ecowitt Cloud from anywhere, and puts everything your station and sensors measure on one clear screen: live conditions at the top, a tile for every reading, then charts, records, forecast and radar. It keeps your history, tracks your records, watches the weather around the clock and alerts you when something matters. Multiple stations, Apple Watch, widgets, Siri. Free, with no ads, no account and no tracking.
WHAT IT SHOWS
• Outdoor temperature with today's high and low
• Indoor temperature and humidity
• Humidity, dew point, feels like
• Pressure with 3-hour trend and outlook
• Wind speed, gusts, direction on a compass
• Rain rate, hourly, today, event, week, month, year
• Rain intensity in words
• Solar radiation and UV index
• Sunrise, sunset, daylight
• Moon phase, moonrise, moonset
• Lightning count and distance
• Air quality: PM2.5, PM10, CO2, AQI
• Soil moisture and soil temperature
• Leaf wetness
• Water level and distance
• Water leaks
• Black globe temperature
• Comfort: how the air feels
• Compared to yesterday
• Battery and signal for every sensor
• Daily, monthly and all-time records
• 5-day forecast, radar and weather warnings
SENSORS
Every sensor paired to your gateway gets its own card: WH31 and WN31 temperature and humidity, WH51 soil moisture, WN34 temperature probes, WN35 leaf wetness, WH41 and WH43 PM2.5, WH45 air quality and CO2, WH55 water leak, WH57 lightning, WH40 and WN40 rain gauges, WS80, WS85 and WS90 Wittboy sensor arrays, WH65 and WS69 arrays, WN36 black globe, LDS01 water level and distance, and the indoor sensors in the gateway or console. Rename and reorder them as you like.
ALERTS
Freeze, frost tonight, high and low temperature, rapid drop, rain starting and stopping, heavy rain, rain totals, wind and gusts, pressure falling or rising fast, lightning nearby, a storm building, humidity, air quality, sensor limits you set, low batteries, a sensor gone quiet, a station offline, firmware updates. Weather warnings from the National Weather Service and Europe's national services. Water-leak alarm that repeats until seen. Daily summary, moon alert at sunset, quiet hours.
HISTORY AND RECORDS
Charts for every reading from one hour to a month, and up to three years on Ecowitt Cloud. Tap a chart for the exact value and time. Highs, lows and totals from today back to all time. Monthly report, CSV export.
FORECAST
5-day forecast for your station's location with the chance of rain. National Weather Service written forecasts (US). Live radar (US and Europe).
APPLE WATCH
Any of your stations on your wrist, with complications for your watch face. With Ecowitt Cloud the watch reads your station itself, without your iPhone.
WIDGETS, LIVE ACTIVITY, SIRI
Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets. A Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island while it rains or lightning is near. Siri and Shortcuts for conditions, temperature and rain. Share a picture of current conditions.
STATIONS
As many stations as you have, local or cloud. Reorder, show or hide any card, tile or chart. Two-column iPad layout. Choice of main rain gauge on two-gauge stations. Firmware status for every device.
HARDWARE
Gateways GW1100, GW1200, GW2000, GW3000, WS6210 and WS6006 (GW1000 through Ecowitt Cloud); consoles HP25xx, HP3500, WS2320, WS2910, WS38xx, WS39xx, WN18xx and WN19xx; and any station built on these, including Wittboy and Essense3. Newer models usually work too. Readings depend on your gateway, firmware and sensors.
Weathervane is independently developed and not affiliated with Ecowitt. Ecowitt and product names are trademarks of their owners.
WEBSITE: https://leechsoftware.com/dashboard-for-ecowitt/
